firmware.title: Bluetooth Firmware Selection
firmware.invalid: %s is not a Realtek firmware file: probably a web page was saved instead of the file. Download it again with the 'plain' link and replace it.
firmware.rom_running: Could not connect: the adapter's firmware is not loaded. Put the files shown on the Adapter screen into the firmware folder, press Restart Bluetooth and connect again.
firmware.rom_status: The firmware is not loaded, so the adapter cannot connect or stream. Put the files shown on the Adapter screen into the firmware folder; Bluetooth then starts again with them.
firmware.rom_short: The adapter cannot connect or stream until these files are there.
firmware.manual_instructions:
1. Click 'Open Download Page' to open kernel.org
2. Download the fw and config files
3. Click 'Open Firmware Folder' and place the files there
firmware.vendor_intel: Intel adapter (experimental). If it starts in bootloader mode, see the setup guide.
firmware.vendor_mediatek: MediaTek adapter (experimental). Its firmware is read from MediaTek's Windows driver.
firmware.vendor_qualcomm: Qualcomm adapter (experimental). Its firmware is read from Qualcomm's Windows driver.
firmware.vendor_broadcom: Broadcom adapter (experimental): no Realtek files needed.
firmware.vendor_csr: CSR adapter: no firmware files needed.
firmware.vendor_barrot: Barrot adapter: no firmware files needed.
firmware.vendor_marvell: Marvell adapter (experimental). The Wi-Fi driver loads its firmware: keep Wi-Fi on.
firmware.vendor_actions: Actions adapter (experimental): no firmware files needed.
firmware.auto_no_adapter: No adapter detected. Bind it to WinUSB with Zadig; Auto then picks the chip when it is connected.
firmware.auto_unrecognized: The adapter was not recognized. If it has a Realtek chip, choose the chip; otherwise choose Not Realtek.
firmware.vendor_unsupported: This adapter needs a firmware loader that BlueCaster does not have (MediaTek / Qualcomm), so BlueCaster cannot use it.
firmware.download_explain: Downloads these files from kernel.org and saves them in the firmware folder.
firmware.download_license: The files are Realtek's proprietary firmware, redistributable under the terms in linux-firmware's WHENCE and LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt. Download them only if you accept those terms.
firmware.downloaded: Firmware downloaded. Bluetooth loads it at the next connection.
firmware.downloading: Downloading the firmware from kernel.org… This can take up to a minute.
firmware.download_slow: The download is taking a while. It goes on in the background.
firmware.download_failed: Could not download the firmware (no connection to kernel.org, or a file did not match). Use Open Download Page to get the files yourself.

ui.setup.title: Set up BlueCaster
ui.setup.intro: A few steps to hear Windows sound through your Bluetooth audio device.
ui.setup.adapter_intro: Select a supported Bluetooth adapter that is not being used by your system:
ui.setup.unsupported_note: BlueCaster cannot use some Qualcomm and MediaTek adapters. Choose another, such as a Realtek one.
ui.setup.driver_ok: The adapter is ready for BlueCaster
ui.setup.auto_explain: To use the adapter, this setup will:

ui.setup.auto_failed: The adapter could not be set up
ui.setup.auto_advanced: You can also do these steps by hand, or undo them, on the Adapters screen.
ui.setup.license_note: By pressing the button, you accept Realtek's license terms (LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt in linux-firmware).
ui.setup.auto_explain_admin: To use the adapter, this setup will do the following (administrator permission required):
